description: Joao de Oliveira Barbosa and Karel van Dalen provide MATLAB and Maple code for the dynamic response of ballasted railway track. The linked TU Delft publication abstract models the rail as an Euler-Bernoulli beam, sleepers as periodically spaced lumped masses, and ballast as a regular lattice of elastically connected masses. A flexible or rigid foundation represents different supporting conditions. A semianalytical frequency-domain solution and numerical inverse Fourier transform produce dispersion curves and time responses. The authors compare this model with lumped supports and a case without the superstructure, and identify assessment of track dynamics as its application. 4TU.ResearchData offers the deposit freely under CC BY 4.0, with 35 file descriptors containing scripts and supporting material. The paper appeared in 2019; the deposit was published in May 2025. Coverage is an idealised track, not a measured network inventory. Settlement assessment is described as future tool development. Field validation, runtime and complete parameter definitions remain unknown. No file body was downloaded or model executed.
